title: plus DOX
ext: For chromatin immunoprecipitation, differentiating day 5 cells were harvested using Accutase, resuspended in ITS/HSA-containing medium and fixed for 10 min by adding freshly thawed formaldehyde solution to a final concentration of 1% (w/v). After stopping with 125 mM glycine, pellets of 5*106 cells were stored at -80Â°C or processed immediately. Samples were lysed in hypotonic Tris buffer and sonicated 35 times with a 30 s on / 30 s off cycling protocol using a Diagenode Bioruptor device at high power (volume: 300 Âµl), to an average DNA fragment size of ~200 bp. Following 10-fold dilution with 50 mM Tris pH8 / 200 mM NaCl / 5 mM EDTA / 0.5 (v/v) NP40, sheared samples were incubated with 10 Âµg of antibody over night at 4Â°C on a rotator. The antibody used was raised against a transgenic ISL1-HA tag. Antibody/chromatin complexes were isolated using Pierce protein A/G-conjugated magnetic beads (Thermo # 26162) and washed repeatedly with high-salt (500 mM NaCl) wash buffer. ChIP samples were eluted using 65Â°C 1% (w/v) SDS-containing buffer, crosslink-reversed in the presence of 200 mM NaCl for 4 h at 65Â°C, treated with RNase A and Proteinase K, and purified on Qiagen PCR purification columns.,Illumina kit # IP-202-1012 following the manufacturer's instructions,Pooled starting material from independent experiments

title: T0_rep1
ext: Genomic DNA was isolated from samples of a minimum of 2E7 cells using the Blood and Cell Culture Midi Kit (Qiagen cat. 13343, Valencia, CA),5Âµl amplicon or 1Âµl diluted plasmid library was used as template in 13 50Âµl Herculase II DNA polymerase reactions per sample to attach pooled variable-length spacers and Illumina indexes (custom primers, see manuscript). 24 cycles were used to amplify DNA in the first and second PCR, respectively. The amplicon fragments after PCR 2 comprise a 354-362bp library with variable 20bp sgRNA sequence in the middle. DNA was pooled by sample and purified using the Nucleospin Gel and PCR Clean-up kit (Clontech cat. 740609.250, Mountain View, CA). DNA was quantified using a Qubit high-sensitivity DNA quantification assay (Thermo Fisher cat. Q32851) and Take3 microspot plate reader (BioTek). DNA quality was analyzed by Experion CHIP assay (BioRad cat. 7007-163, Hercules, CA). Clusters were generated on the flow cell using the HiSeq Rapid Duo CBot Sample Loading Kit (Illumina CT- cat. 403-2001, San Diego, CA).,A single-read rapid run of 75 cycles was performed on a HiSeq 1500 (Illumina cat. GD-402-4002) using the HiSeq Rapid SBS kit (Illumina cat. FC-402-4022) with 10% PhiX.

title: CPEP1_TEM_2 scATAC-seq
ext: Nuclei were exteacted for ATAC-Seq.,For ATAC-Seq, nuclei were isolated from FACS purified tetramer+ beta cell-specific CD8 T cells and polyclonal Tem and naive CD8 T cells from T1D donors using the Low Cell Input Nuclei Isolation protocol from 10x Genomics. The transposition reaction was then performed on the bulk nuclei. The transposed nuclei were partitioned into nanoliter-scale barcoded Gel Beads-in-emulsion (GEMs) after running the loaded Chromium microfluidic Chip E on the Chromium Controller, and the transposed DNA was uniquely indexed and barcoded for each individual nucleus per manufacturerâs instructions (10x Genomics). Libraries were generated and sequenced using Illumina Hiseq system following the manufacturer's protocols. For each sample, the single cell ATAC data were mapped to hg38 using the Cell Ranger ATAC pipeline.  We then used SnapATAC (https://github.com/r3fang/SnapATAC) to combine multiple samples, i.e. the fragment.tsv files generated by Cell Ranger ATAC pipeline, and performed the clustering analysis.,scATAC-Seq, the libraries were paired-end (50bp+49bp) sequenced

title: Recurrent, [225Ac]hu11B6 tx, LNCaP-AR s.c. tumor 1
ext: RNA from snap frozen LNCaP-AR tumors was extracted using the RNeasy Mini Kit (QIAGEN) according to the instructions provided by the manufacturer.,After RiboGreen quantification and quality control by Agilent BioAnalyzer, 500 ng of total RNA underwent polyA selection and TruSeq library preparation according to instructions provided by Illumina (RS-122-2102, TruSeq Stranded mRNA LT Kit) with 8 cycles of PCR. Samples were barcoded and run on a HiSeq 4000 in a 50bp/50bp paired end run, using the HiSeq 3000/4000 SBS Kit (Illumina). An average of 44 million paired reads was generated per sample. Ribosomal reads represented maximally 1.2% of the reads generated and the percent of mRNA bases averaged 63%.

title: Melanoma cells - G1 1K
ext: COLO829 cells from ATCC (American Type Culture Collection) were cultured in their recommended media conditions at 37Â°C. Prior to FACS sorting, the cancer cell line was trypsinized, followed by inactivation with FBS and washed by centrifugation at 300g in 1X PBS with 0.04% BSA. Cells were counted and resuspended in recommended media at a final concentration of 1e6/mL in a FACS tube. 2 Î¼L of VybrantÂ® DyeCycleâ¢ Green stain was added to the cell suspension and incubated at 37Â°C for 30 minutes in the dark. Cells were then analyzed and sorted on a flow cytometer using 488 nm excitation and green emission gating on cells in the G1 phase of the cell cycle.,The Single-cell suspension was processed using Chromium Single-Cell CNV Solution (10x Genomics) as described in the user guide to generating a barcoded single-cell DNA library. single-cells were partitioned in a hydrogel matrix by combining with a CB polymer to form Cell beads (CBs) using a microfluidic chip. Post the first encapsulation, CBs are treated to lyse the encapsulated cells and denature the genomic DNA (gDNA). The denatured gDNA in the CB is then accessible to amplification and barcoding. A second microfluidic encapsulation step is required to partition the CB with 10x barcode Gel Beads (GBs) to generate an emulsion called GEMs. Immediately after barcoding and amplification, 10x barcoded fragments were pooled and attached to standard Illumina adaptors.,Sequencing libraries were quantified by qPCR before sequencing on the Illumina platform using NovaSeq S4 chemistry with 2x100 paired-end reads.

title: 22RV1_DMSO_ATAC_1
ext: 50,000 live cells in culture medium were treated with DNase at a final concentration of 200 U/ml at 37C for 30 minutes. The cells were washed thrice with PBS to remove DNase followed by lysis with RSB (10mM Tris-HCl, 10mM NaCl, 3 mM MgCl2) containing 0.1% NP40, 0.1% Tween-20, and 0.01% Digitonin and mixed by pipetting up and down 3 times. The cells were lysed on ice for 3 minutes and the reaction was stopped by adding 1ml of ice cold RSB containing 0.1% Tween-20 and mixed by inverting the tubes thrice. The nuclei were pelleted by centrifugation at 4C and the pellet was resuspended in 50ul of transposition mix (25ul 2x TD buffer, 2.5ul transposase, 16.5ul PBS, 0.5ul 1% digitonin, 0.5ul 10% Tween-20, 5ul H2O) and was incubated at 37C for 30 minutes with mixing. The reaction was then cleaned up with a Zymo DNA Clean and Concentrator-5 Kit.,Library preparations for the samples were performed as described in Buenrostro et al., 2013 with minor changes. In brief to generate multiplexed libraries, A preamplification cycle was performed with the transposed DNA. The DNA was amplified for 5 PCR cycles with Illumina indexed primers (Nextera index kit, Illumina), 25ul of NEBNext High-Fidelity 2x PCR Master Mix (New England Biolabs). 5ul of this amplified DNA was amplified further using a qPCR to determine the appropriate number of cycles of PCR cycles needed to achieve maximum amplification with minimum duplicates. The number of cycles needed was calculated by finding the cycle number that corresponds to 1/4th of the maximum fluorescence intensity. The final amplification was performed in the leftover 45ul from the preamplification reaction using the number of cycles calculated in the qPCR.

title: 127457 S1 k4me3
ext: 150.000 cells were washed twice with Wash Buffer (20mM MHEPES, 150mM NaCl, 0,5mM Spermidine) and bound to activated Concavalin A beads for 10 minutes at room temperature. Cell-bead suspension was then resuspended in antibody buffer (20mM MHEPES, 150mM NaCl, 0,5mM Spermidine, 0,05% Digitonin, 2mM EDTA) and incubated overnight at 4Â°C with H3K27ac (Active Motif #39133) and H3K4me3 (Active Motif #39159) antibodies (antibody dilution 1:50). Cell-bead suspension was then washed twice with Digitonin Buffer (20mM MHEPES, 150mM NaCl, 0,5mM Spermidine, 0,05% Digitonin) and incubated with 2.5 Âµl EpiCypher CUTANA pAG-MNase, for 10 minutes. After washing samples twice with Digitonin buffer, 1Âµl 100mM CaCl2 was added to samples which were incubated for 2 hours at 4Â°C, rotating. To stop the reaction, STOP buffer (340mM Nacl, 20mm EDTA, 4mM EGTA, 0,02%Digitonin, 50Âµg/ml RNase A, 50ug/ml Glycogen, yeast genomic DNA) was added in each tube. Samples were incubated at 37Â°C for 10 minutes at 500 rpm and after centrifugation, liquid was collected, DNA was purified using Zymo DNA clean concentrator kit and DNA was eluted in elution buffer.,For library preparation we used the TruSeq DNA nano kit and protocol from Illumina with 15 cycles of PCR. Libraries were validated and quantified (Agilent Tape Station 4200).,A pool of all libraries was quantified by using the Peqlab KAPA Library Quantification Kit and the Applied Biosystems 7900HT Sequence Detection System. Sequencing was done with NovaSeq sequencers (Illumina) and a PE100bp read length aiming at 10M reads/sample.

ext: ChIP-seq protocol Cells were harvested following 72-hr exposure to specified lentivirus and 4 day selection with 2 Î¼g/ml of puromycin. ChIP experiments were performed per standard protocols (Millipore, Billerica, MA) with minor modifications. Briefly, cells were cross-linked for 10 min with 1% formaldehyde at 37 Â°C. This reaction was subsequently quenched with 125 mM glycine for 5 min and 10 million fixed cells were used per ChIP experiment. Chromatin from fixed cells was fragmented by sonication with a Covaris E220 and the solubilized chromatin was incubated with the indicated antibody listed overnight at 4Â°C. Antibody-chromatin complexes were pulled down by incubation with Protein G-Dynabeads (Thermo Scientific) for 2 hours at 4Â°C, washed, and eluted. The samples then underwent crosslink reversal, RNase A (Roche) treatment, and proteinase K (Thermo Scientific) treatment before the captured DNA was extracted with AMPure XP beads (Beckman Coulter). Briefly, 50K cells were incubated in hypotonic buffer and lysis buffer, then were resuspended in transposase reaction mixture for 30 min at 37Â°C with gentle shaking followed by DNA purification and 12 cycles of amplification. title: Input library rep1
ext: Cells were harvested 48 h post-transfection and total RNA was extracted using the RNeasy Midi Kit (Qiagen). PolyA RNA was purified from total RNA using Dynabeads Oligo(dT)25 beads (Invitrogen) with 2:1 bead to total RNA volume ratio. The isolated polyA RNA was treated with Turbo DNaseI (Ambion) and purified using RNeasy MinElute clean up kit (Qiagen).,Reverse transcription of reporter transcript mRNA was performed using a gene-specific primer containing a 10 nt unique molecular identified (UMI). After reverse transcription, RNA was remove by RNase A treatment and the cDNA was purified with AMPure XP beads using a 1.8:1 beads to cDNA ratio. The cDNA-s were amplified using a reporter-specific PCR amplicon targeting an exon-exon junction to minimize potential contribution from plasmid DNA. The junction PCR products were purified using AMPure XPbeads with beads to sample ratio of 0.8. A second PCR step was run to add the Illumina multiplexing indices for sequencing (NEBNext Multiplex Oligos for Illumina Dual Index Primers Set 1 and 2). The final library PCR product was purified using SPRIselect beads (Beckman) with a bead to sample ratio of 0.8. title: COVID-19 blood rep1 (ADT)
ext: Blood was collected bedside via standarad venipuncture into EDTA (lavender top) or sodium heparin (green top) vacutainer tubes. Blood was maintainted and transferred to the laboratory at room temperature for processing. Plasma from whole blood was isolated via centrifugation at 400 x g for 10 min at 4ËC. Untouched circulating leukocytes were isolated using the EasySepâ¢ RBC Depletion Reagent (StemCell Technologies; Cat. #18170). Endotractheal aspirates (ETA) were collected bedside and transported to the laboratory at room temperature where it was then placed at 4ËC for processing in BSL3 containment. ETA was mixed 1:1 with a 50mM EDTA solution (final concentration 25 mM EDTA) in custom RPMI-1640 media deficient in biotin, L-glutamine, phenol red, riboflavin, and sodium bicarbonate (defRPMI-1640), with 3% newborn calf serum (NBCS) and mechanically dissociated using a syringe to liberate leukocytes from mucins and other respiratory secretions. ETA cells underwent an additional mechanical dissociation step using 1-3 mL of a 10 mM EDTA in defRPMI-1640 + 3% NBCS and a P1000 pipettor. Cells were then washed with 10 mL defRPMI-1640 + 3% NBCS, passed through a 70 Âµm nylon strainer, and pelleted through a 2 mL 100% NBCS layer. Leukocytes from whole blood and ETA samples were incubated with oligo-conjugated Ig-A/D/G/M for 10 min at 4ËC followed by the addition of Human TruStain FcXâ¢ (BioLegend; Cat #422302) and 10 min incubation at RT. Cells were then surface stained with oligo-conjugated monoclonal antibody panel (total 89 antibodies; Extended Data Table 5) for 30 min at 4ËC, followed by two washes in def-RPMI-1640/0.04% BSA. Cells were resuspended at a concentration of 1200-1500 cells/ÂµL in def-RPMI-1640/0.04% BSA and passed through a 20 (blood) or 40 Âµm (ETA) cell strainer before loading onto a Chromium Controller (10X Genomics, Pleasanton, CA).,Gene expression (GEX) and antibody-derived tag (ADT) libraries were generated using the Chromium Single Cell 5â² Library & Gel Bead Kit v1.1 with feature barcoding following the manufacturer's instructions (https://support.10xgenomics.com/single-cell-vdj/index/doc/user-guide-chromium-single-cell-vdj-reagent-kits-user-guide-v11-chemistry-with-feature-barcoding-technology-for-cell-surface-protein).

title: Synthetic_Library
ext: Twenty-four hours post-transfection, cells were pelleted and washed with DPBS. Total RNA was extracted using Trizol (Invitrogen, 12183555). From 75 Î¼g of total RNA per sample, mRNAs were isolated using the Dynabeads mRNA Purification Kit (Invitrogen, 61006). Residual DNA was removed from 1 Î¼g of mRNA using ezDNase (Invitrogen, 11766051).,All mRNAs were subjected to a reverse-transcription reaction in 8-strip PCR tubes, using a custom primerï¼R-amp1-UMI12-rd2, GTGACTGGAGTTCAGACGTGTGCTCTTCCGATCTNNNNNNNNNNNNggccgtttacgtcgccgtccï¼ FS-TSO, AAGCAGTGGTATCAACGCAGAGTACrGrGrGï¼ and the SuperScript IV First Strand Synthesis Kit (Invitrogen, 18091050). The resulting cDNA was purified using the QIAquick PCR Purification Kit (Qiagen, 28506). The purified cDNA was split into 8 PCR tubes and amplified using NEBNext Ultra II Q5 Master Mix (NEB, M0544S) and F-TSO(ISPCR)-rd1( ACACTCTTTCCCTACACGACGCTCTTCCGATCTAAGCAGTGGTATCAACGCAGAG) and P7-i7(index)-rd2(CAAGCAGAAGACGGCATACGAGATNNNNNNNNGTGACTGGAGTTCAGACGTGTGCTCTTCCGATCT) primers for three cycles. After the PCR reaction, all eight tubes for each sample were combined in a DNA LoBind tube. PCR products were purified using AMPure XP (Beckman Coulter, A63881) and then further amplified using P5-i5-rd1(AATGATACGGCGACCACCGAGATCTACACNNNNNNNNACACTCTTTCCCTACACGACGCTCTTCCGATCT) and P7(CAAGCAGAAGACGGCATACGAGAT) primers for seven PCR cycles to add P5, P7, and unique 8 bp Illumina index sequences. Similarly, plasmid DNA was amplified in 2x50 Î¼L reactions using NGS-F and NGS-R primers and amplified using NGS-P5 (ACACTCTTTCCCTACACGACGCTCTTCCGATCTGTGGATAACCGTATTACCGCCATGC), and NGS-P7(GACTGGAGTTCAGACGTGTGCTCTTCCGATCTTGAACAGCTCCTCGCCCTTG) primers for seven PCR cycles to add P5, P7. Following SPRI (Beckman Coulter, B23319) cleanup, amplicons were sequenced using a NovaSeq 6000 SP flow cell with a 15% PhiX spike-in.

title: BM0106-UNK-RNA-1
ext: All cells described here were FACS sorted prior to performing the assay.,RNA was isolated using the Qiagen RNeasy Plus Micro kit, and RNA was eluted in 10 Î¼l of RNase-free water. 5 Î¼l of total RNA was used as input for NuGen Ovation V2 cDNA synthesis kit. The yield of purified SPIA-amplified cDNA was measured using Qubit dsDNA HS Assay kit. 50 ng of SPIA cDNA was fragmented using Nextera DNA library preparation kit (Illumina, FC-121-1030). Fragmented SPIA cDNA was then purified using Qiagen MinElute Reaction Cleanup Kit, and purified DNA was eluted in 10 Î¼l of elution buffer (10mM Tris-HCl, pH 8). Purified SPIA cDNA fragments was amplified and purified as previously described for ATAC-seq17. ATAC-seq and RNA-seq libraries were quantified using qPCR, amplified libraries were sequenced using paired-end, dual-index sequencing on a NextSeq 500 instrument with 76 bp read lengths.
